description: All sandbox environments enforce ComputeNetworkMode 'none' or 'loopback-only'. No evaluation job permits external network access.

preconditions.description: An evaluation job is submitted to the Compute Fabric

expectedOutcome.description: The sandbox job spec networkPolicy.mode is always 'none' or 'loopback-only'. shouldBlockNetworkAccess returns true for all external destinations in 'none' mode.
